chunks.title: IETF Internet-Draft: The Idempotency-Key HTTP Header Field (draft-ietf-httpapi-idempotency-key-header-06, work in progress)
chunks.excerpt: The HTTP Idempotency-Key request header field can be used to make non-idempotent HTTP methods such as POST or PATCH fault-tolerant.

chunks.title: IETF Internet-Draft: The Idempotency-Key HTTP Header Field (draft-ietf-httpapi-idempotency-key-header-06, work in progress)
chunks.excerpt: An idempotency key is a unique value generated by the client which the resource uses to recognize subsequent retries of the same request.
